scope: Exact generated-separator render/physical deltas in all8 native districts. The existing geometric/continuation gates remain; only full2m body height replaces wheel-height-only matching. Complete source road XZ, deck tops, grades, legality and all non-generated collision records outside the two SeaTac models remain unchanged.
retakeMaskPolicy: Use each removed/added renderedFootprintXZ and YRange, plus the separate two-model impact bounds. ROOT owns conservative shadow/raster padding and actual fresh-source retakes; original frame source/date never changes.
